description: 10-bus, 69-bus, and 873-bus radial distribution feeder for power flow is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Pedro Vasconcelos. This dataset supports the study in the paper titled "A Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Model to Support the Operation of Distribution Systems with Hidden DERs." The data includes the system data and equivalent Distributed Energy Resource (DER) allocations for three test cases: a 10-bus system, the IEEE 69-bus radial test feeder, and an 873-bus radial test feeder. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
